title: [29x] Additional Reporting Currency Difference After Closing Income Statement - related to 625803
summary: Fixes differences in the additional reporting currency that remained after running the Close Income Statement report. The report is updated in the W1, ES and IT layers, a new Close Inc. Stmt. ACY Handler codeunit is added, and Gen. Jnl.-Post Line is adjusted in the ES layer.
key_points: New codeunit Close Inc. Stmt. ACY Handler added for additional reporting currency during income statement closing
Close Income Statement report changed in the W1, ES and IT layers
Gen. Jnl.-Post Line adjusted in the ES layer
Tests added in several country layers to cover the fix
